title: How Drunk Florida Woman's Poker Club Defiance Ends In Arrest Chaos!
description:
On December 17th, 2023, in Florida, officers responded to a disturbance at a local poker club. The incident began when a woman, who had become highly intoxicated, was asked to leave the premises. Her boyfriend escorted her out, but moments later, she returned and had to be restrained by security. Upon officers' arrival, the woman continued to yell and fall to the ground, refusing to follow orders.

During her arrest for disorderly conduct, the woman became increasingly combative. While waiting for prisoner transport, she raised her left leg and kicked an officer in the thigh. Despite the kick not causing significant injuries, it was forceful enough to shift the officer’s leg. The woman’s behavior remained erratic and uncooperative throughout the ordeal.

After the kick, the officers managed to restrain her fully and transported her to the local precinct. The suspect resisted and created a scene, making the situation challenging for law enforcement. The suspect was charged with Obstructing Or Resisting an Officer Without Violence,  Battery On A Law Enforcement Officer, and Felony Trespass In Structure Or Conveyance Resisting An Officer With Violence Felony.
